artifact_observations.reasoning: The base of the pole appears to be mounted on a wheeled cart or trolley with large spoked wheels. This is structurally nonsensical for a maypole, which requires a heavy, fixed foundation to support the tension of the ribbons and the height of the pole. A mobile base would be unstable.
The texture of the brickwork and the road surface is overly smooth and 'smudged,' lacking fine granular detail. Edges between buildings and sky show slight haloing/bleeding.
The connection points where the children's hands grasp the ribbons are indistinct. In several cases, the ribbon seems to merge into the hand or arm without a clear grip geometry.
The wheels at the base appear elliptical and inconsistent with the perspective of the ground plane. One wheel seems to float slightly above the ground contact point.

To assess the general coherence and identify any subtle texture smearing or generative artifacts in the background.
